scope: Implementation working tree before commit. Full Windows checks are complemented by targeted reruns after final changes. GitHub Actions independently validates the pushed main commit.

environment.development: Windows amd64, Intel Core i5-9400F, Go 1.27.3, Node 24.18.0
environment.linux: Disposable Ubuntu 24.04 amd64 VM under QEMU
environment.browser: Installed Google Chrome; desktop 1280x900 and touch viewport 390x844

schemas.migration: None; initialize a fresh installation directory.

changes: Canonical UUIDs and per-inbound effective identity uniqueness, with an independent runtime duplicate guard. TUIC can rotate its password while retaining its UUID; unchanged normalized authentication is rejected.
Node and VPN profile models no longer contain shared UUIDs or passwords. Runtime users and exports obtain authentication exclusively from account credentials.
Credential commands separated into application use cases; runtimeconfig owns supported component types and official-core projections.
Preview, save and apply validate the managed binary; advertised capabilities are checked against registered options. Release builds include QUIC, uTLS, WireGuard and gVisor.
Generated frontend contracts cover configuration, accounts, credentials, grants, tasks and sessions. checkJs includes every frontend module, without claiming strict TypeScript coverage.
Structured panel API errors, field focus, preserved conflict drafts, task result links and abortable request/dialog ownership.
Cursor task history with independent failure/active counts, bounded overview summaries and safe concurrent/failed navigation.
Lazy gzip compression for embedded JS/CSS with encoding-specific strong ETags and correct revalidation/range behavior.
Authorization snapshots select only required fields and reuse the scanner while retaining durable reservations, period rollover and revocation checks.
Backup decryption streams database and certificate entries to private staging; complete age authentication precedes publication; all successful owners close staging.
Responsive account identity/quota displays and grouped node transport/TLS fields. Probe startup gateway errors receive at most two retries within the original timeout.
Removed obsolete shared-credential test implementations; synchronized current schema, build flags, API and ownership documentation.

local_validation.note: Real sing-box and Mihomo executables were configured. A previous gRPC startup 502 exposed inconsistent transient-response handling; bounded retries and an HTTP regression were added before this successful run.

local_validation.command: go test ./internal/accounting; managed-runtime account isolation and credential publication targeted tests
local_validation.note: Rerun after final TUIC password rotation and platform error-message changes.

local_validation.command: go vet ./...; go run ./cmd/panel-contract -check; npm run typecheck; npm test
local_validation.scope: Eight frontend suites, including delayed response cancellation, field focus and failed/competing task history navigation.

Real HTTP API, account binding/export, equivalent-UUID rejection without partial state, unsupported DNS preview/save rejection, current schema and absent node secrets, desktop/mobile keyboard/pointer/touch workflows.
local_validation.visual_review: Desktop and mobile screenshots inspected; quota exhaustion colors and duplicate identity display corrected and rechecked.

local_validation.scope: Linux amd64 and arm64 manager/runtime builds with all advertised build flags; actual linked-module license inventory refreshed.

linux_validation.scope: ENOSPC rejects uncommitted reservations; recovery integrity_check=ok; SIGKILL preserves the complete durable reservation.
IPv4/IPv6 forwarding and project-owned rule cleanup.
OpenVPN, tunnel DNS and fail-closed isolated networking.
Startup journal recovery, firewall restoration, unexpected clean-exit restart and intentional stop preservation.

linux_validation.command: Fresh release sb.sh install; scripts/test-platform-linux.py; scripts/test-access-maintenance-linux.py
linux_validation.scope: New data directory and systemd deployment; independent account export/QR/grants; stopped-state preservation; failed application rollback; live certificate replacement; independent subscription TLS; panel listener/TLS restart and rollback; task retention and project journal cleanup.
linux_validation.fixture_notes: An initial isolated-root attempt encountered the preceding disposable installation's owned firewall chains. The old manager removed those chains before the successful retry. After acceptance, the preceding VM installation, its firewall and active services were restored.

linux_validation.scope: Complete Go race suite and real TCP/UDP protocol matrix. The duplicate local QEMU race compilation was stopped after this exact pushed-code check passed. Remaining workflow checks are tracked by the linked repository workflow rather than inferred from this one successful step.

benchmarks.interpretation: Authorization allocation bytes fell about 46.6% and allocation count 50.9%. Baseline timings were affected by concurrent builds and scheduling, so no controlled speedup ratio or production proxy throughput claim is made. WAL/FULL durability remains enabled.

cleanup.note: Superseded audit artifacts and failed panel fixtures were moved into the existing ignored manual-cleanup area after the earlier recursive deletion block. Development tools, dependency caches, VM base/overlay disks and current verification artifacts are retained.

limits: No protocol-level online user hot update: credential publication still uses necessary restarts, persisted retries and fresh-heartbeat confirmation.
No production-duration soak test or physical OpenWrt/LuCI acceptance in this run.
ARM64 is cross-built; native execution and host-specific networking still require deployment-platform acceptance.
Streamed backup staging removes archive-sized byte buffers, but scrypt retains its fixed memory cost.
Local logs and screenshots are ignored diagnostic artifacts; this document records reproducible commands and their observed scope.
